Overview
Apply your software development education and experience as a member of our software development team. You will build and release Esri software technologies focused on the intersection between GIS, photogrammetry and remote sensing for the defense and intelligence communities. In this role, you will collaborate with a talented team of software developers and product engineers to create, build, test, and release advanced software technologies focused on imagery users. This is an exciting opportunity to focus your programming skills on designing and building powerful tools to support a wide variety of analytical workflows and imagery sources (such as MS and HSI, TIR, RADAR, LiDAR, Motion Imagery, and other remotely sensed data and information).
Responsibilities
System Design, Software Architecture, and Software Implementation of Esri's GIS Software Products
Utilize a strong understanding of the user requirements to motivate the design and implementation of the systems they work on, as well as a strong understanding of GIS and Geospatial Technology
Participate in the development of ArcGIS software products by writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code
Define, implement, maintain, and document software code architecture, algorithms, and data structures
Collaborate with engineers, designers, and product managers to identify requirements for development of products, features, fixes, functionality, and/or capabilities
Translate software requirements into technical specifications
Write and participate in code reviews of software code written by self and others to ensure quality code is merged into the software following coding standards
Maintain code in a comprehensive shared repository. Analyze and repair software defects
Collaborate with engineers to develop and execute comprehensive test plans and ensure software quality
Plan and execute software development projects following software development methodologies
Stay current in existing and emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices
Requirements
One (1) year of experience in the job offered, or one (1) year of experience in a related occupation
Must demonstrate experience in Java, Servlets, JSP, TLS and PKI, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and REST
Bachelor’s degree, or foreign equivalent degree, in Computer Science, Engineering, GIS, or a related field
